listing.name: Super Smash Bros. Melee — Melee macOS Recompilation (McDandle) (McDandle)
listing.summary: The project reports native gameplay at about 60 FPS in strict mode. Build this source-only port using your own matching disc. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA GALE01 revision 2 disc as ISO, GCM or CISO. RVZ and WBFS are rejected.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Build from source and generate the game code locally using your own game module and data. No ready game package is offered by this source route.

warnings: The project reports native gameplay at about 60 FPS in strict mode. This is a source-only route.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
